dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: *gasp* No way... So that guest really...?

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: I was on duty that morning, and it seemed like no one had left.

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: But I cleaned all the guest rooms on the second floor, and guess what I noticed? All the rooms were empty...

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: *gasp* No. Friggin'. Way! That's sooo creepy... So what happened then?

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: Then I asked Adelinde... Like hey, what happened to the guest who arrived last night!?

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: And she totally ignored me! She was just like, watering the flowers in the garden and talking to herself...

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: She was all like, "Next year when these flowers are in season they will look gorgeous."
